articles.title: Dark Matter Detector Records a Puzzling Signal — But Scientists Stay Cautious
articles.summary: The LZ dark matter experiment detected a single unexplained particle interaction. It could be a WIMP, but it's only 2.6 sigma — not enough for a discovery. More data will tell.

articles.title: Longer Exhales Might Make You More Daring — Science Says So
articles.summary: A new study found that breathing out longer increases heart rate variability and makes the brain more reward-focused, leading to riskier decisions. Could help with anxiety and depression.

articles.title: AI Takes the Wheel in Fusion Experiments, Reacting in Milliseconds
articles.summary: Princeton researchers developed PACMAN, an AI framework that controls fusion plasma in ~20 milliseconds. It predicted a tearing mode 200 ms early. Tested on DIII-D tokamak.
